about_the_game:
A dystopian future

Waking up in a cold, metallic chamber, your vision gradually focuses on the sterile white walls surrounding you. Before you can gather yourself, an energetic scientist bursts into the room. Adeline greets you, welcoming you to your new life as a Soulfused. A hybrid of human consciousness in a robotic body, forged to serve an unyielding Empire.

As you begin your service, you'll navigate a world where the Empire's iron grip has extinguished nearly all resistance. Yet, whispers of rebellion persist in the shadows, and you'll soon find yourself torn between loyalty, morality, and self-rediscovery.

A modern text adventure

Soulfused is a modern homage to the classic text adventures of the earlier days of computer gaming and the entire game is controlled via text input. Classic commands such as GO NORTH or TAKE KEY are all you need to navigate the world of Soulfused, but your journey is made more convenient through the use of additional features such as auto-complete and input history.

short_description: Soulfused is a modern take on the classic text adventures from the early days of computer gaming. It is set in a dystopian future ruled by an empire focused on conquest and control. The player takes the role of a newly converted Soulfused; a part human/part robot soldier in service to the Empire.
